chunks.doc: 📨️ App command laws: the fixture helpers, the AppCommand round trips, the transaction forms, the paged route admission laws, the opening and the merge commands.
🎞️ App frame laws: the AppFrame round trips, the child pack and head commands and frames, the transaction frames, the merge report, conflicts and the UI patch and snapshot frames.
🚫️ Codec refusal laws: encoding determinism, the refusals of empty, unknown, truncated and trailing bytes, the presence roster limits and the paged generic decoder laws.

📚️ Fixture corpus laws: the golden command and frame corpus, the channel version pin and the shared cross-language vectors of the transaction, opening, merge, media export and document identity fixtures.
🗃️ Archive load host laws: the scripted commands and the scripted outcome of the stepped whole-document load.
